        /* ===========================================
           FRAMEWORK DIAGRAM (Slide 4)
           =========================================== */
        .framework-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: auto auto;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .framework-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .framework-item.full-width {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.1), rgba(124,58,237,0.1));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.2);
        }

        .framework-item h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .framework-item p {
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .challenge-label {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            padding: var(--element-gap);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GAE VISUAL (Slide 5)
           =========================================== */
        .gae-visual {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-around;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            padding: var(--content-gap) 0;
        }

        .gae-bar-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .gae-bar {
            width: clamp(40px, 8vw, 80px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 4px;
        }

        .gae-bar-fill {
            background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent), var(--accent-secondary));
            border-radius: 3px;
            width: 100%;
            transition: height 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .gae-label {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .gae-label strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BAR CHART (Slide 6)
           =========================================== */
        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            height: min(55vh, 400px);
            padding: var(--content-gap);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-top: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .bar-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            flex: 1;
            max-width: 150px;
        }

        .bar {
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent-secondary), var(--accent));
            border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: center;
            padding-top: 0.5rem;
            transition: height 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        .bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .bar.highlight-bar {
            background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent), #00ffcc);
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .chart-source {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
            text-align: center;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           TRAINING CURVE (Slide 7)
           =========================================== */
        .curve-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            flex: 1;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .curve-image {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .curve-image img {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: 100%;
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        .curve-stats {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            justify-content: center;
            min-width: 200px;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: var(--element-gap) var(--content-gap);
        }

        .stat-card h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .stat-card .value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .stat-card .subtext {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ABLATION TABLE (Slide 8)
           =========================================== */
        .ablation-container {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .ablation-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 2fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            align-items: center;
            padding: var(--element-gap) 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }

        .ablation-row.header {
            border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
            padding-bottom: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .ablation-component {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .ablation-score {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .ablation-bar-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 4px;
            height: 24px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .ablation-bar {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-secondary), var(--accent));
            transition: width 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .ablation-row.highlight {
            background: rgba(0,212,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: var(--element-gap) var(--content-gap);
            margin: calc(-1 * var(--element-gap)) calc(-1 * var(--content-gap));
        }

        .ablation-row.highlight .ablation-bar {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #00ffcc);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .ablation-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--danger);
            font-style: italic;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           TAKEAWAYS (Slide 9)
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            flex: 1;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: var(--content-gap);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
        }

        .takeaway-item:nth-child(2) { border-left-color: var(--accent-secondary); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(3) { border-left-color: var(--success); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(4) { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(5) { border-left-color: #f472b6; }

        .takeaway-icon {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .takeaway-item:nth-child(2) .takeaway-icon { color: var(--accent-secondary); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(3) .takeaway-icon { color: var(--success); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(4) .takeaway-icon { color: var(--warning); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(5) .takeaway-icon { color: #f472b6; }

        .takeaway-text h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .takeaway-text p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR & NAV
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .nav-dot:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESPONSIVE
           =========================================== */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            .nav-dots { display: none; }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Progress Bar -->
    <div class="progress-bar"></div>

    <!-- Navigation Dots -->
    <nav class="nav-dots"></nav>

    <!-- ===========================================
         SLIDE 1: TITLE
         =========================================== -->
    <section class="slide title-slide">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h1 class="reveal">VAPO: Value-Model-Based RL<br>for Advanced Reasoning</h1>
            <p class="subtitle reveal">Achieving State-of-the-Art on AIME 2024</p>

            <div class="badge-row reveal">
                <span class="badge accent">AIME 2024: <strong>60.4</strong></span>
                <span class="badge">Base: Qwen2.5-32B</span>
                <span class="badge">No SFT Data</span>
                <span class="badge">ByteDance Seed</span>
            </div>

            <p class="authors reveal">Surpassing DAPO by <strong style="color: var(--accent)">10+ points</strong></p>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===========================================
         SLIDE 2: MOTIVATION
         =========================================== -->
    <section class="slide content-slide">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <h2 class="reveal">Why Value Models?</h2>
                <span class="slide-number reveal">02 / 09</span>
            </div>

            <p class="reveal" style="margin-bottom: var(--content-gap); max-width: 800px;">Value-model-free methods (GRPO, DAPO) assign trajectory-level advantage uniformly. For long chain-of-thought reasoning, this is insufficient.</p>

            <div class="two-column">
                <div class="reveal">
                    <h3>Value-Model-Free</h3>
                    <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: 8px; padding: var(--content-gap); margin-bottom: var(--element-gap);">
                        <p style="color: var(--danger); font-weight: 500;">GRPO / DAPO</p>
                        <ul style="margin-top: var(--element-gap); padding-left: 1.2rem;">
                            <li>Uniform advantage across all tokens</li>
                            <li>Final reward only</li>
                            <li>Token-level errors invisible</li>
                            <li>High variance estimates</li>
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="reveal">
                    <h3>Value-Model-Based</h3>
                    <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.1), rgba(124,58,237,0.1)); border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.3); border-radius: 8px; padding: var(--content-gap);">
                        <p style="color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500;">VAPO</p>
                        <ul style="margin-top: var(--element-gap); padding-left: 1.2rem;">
                            <li>Token-level credit assignment</li>
                            <li>Lower variance estimates</li>
                            <li>Generalizes across samples</li>
                            <li>Precise error tracing</li>
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===========================================
         SLIDE 3: THREE CORE CHALLENGES
         =========================================== -->
    <section class="slide content-slide">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <h2 class="reveal">Three Challenges in Value-Model-Based RL</h2>
                <span class="slide-number reveal">03 / 09</span>
            </div>

            <div class="three-column">
                <div class="challenge-card reveal">
                    <h3>1. Value Model Bias</h3>
                    <p>Long trajectories and bootstrapped learning compound estimation errors, leading to biased value estimates that degrade policy learning.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="challenge-card reveal" style="border-left-color: var(--accent);">
                    <h3 style="color: var(--accent);">2. Heterogeneous Lengths</h3>
                    <p>Responses vary from short answers to 6,000+ token chains. Different lengths require different bias-variance tradeoffs—but one λ is used for all.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="challenge-card reveal" style="border-left-color: var(--success);">
                    <h3 style="color: var(--success);">3. Reward Signal Sparsity</h3>
                    <p>Only the final <eos> token receives reward. All intermediate tokens in long chains get zero credit signal.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===========================================
         SLIDE 4: VAPO FRAMEWORK
         =========================================== -->
    <section class="slide content-slide">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <h2 class="reveal">VAPO Framework: Integrated Solutions</h2>
                <span class="slide-number reveal">04 / 09</span>
            </div>

            <div class="framework-grid">
                <div class="framework-item reveal">
                    <h4>Value-Pretraining</h4>
                    <p>Pre-trains value model before RL to reduce initial bias</p>
                </div>
                <div class="framework-item reveal">
                    <h4>Decoupled-GAE</h4>
                    <p>Separates GAE computation for robust value estimation</p>
                </div>
                <div class="framework-item reveal">
                    <h4>Length-Adaptive GAE</h4>
                    <p>Dynamic λ adjustment based on response length</p>
                </div>

                <p class="challenge-label reveal">Each technique addresses a core challenge:</p>

                <div class="framework-item reveal" style="border-left: 3px solid var(--danger);">
                    <p style="color: var(--danger); font-size: var(--small-size);">Challenge 1</p>
                    <p>Value-Pretraining + Decoupled-GAE</p>
                </div>
                <div class="framework-item reveal" style="border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);">
                    <p style="color: var(--accent); font-size: var(--small-size);">Challenge 2</p>
                    <p>Length-Adaptive GAE</p>
                </div>
                <div class="framework-item reveal" style="border-left: 3px solid var(--success);">
                    <p style="color: var(--success); font-size: var(--small-size);">Challenge 3</p>
                    <p>All components improve signal propagation</p>
                </div>

                <div class="framework-item full-width reveal">
                    <h4>Supporting Techniques</h4>
                    <p style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">Clip-Higher (exploration) • Token-level Loss (normalization) • Positive Example LM Loss (self-imitation) • Group-Sampling (baseline estimation)</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===========================================
         SLIDE 5: LENGTH-ADAPTIVE GAE
         =========================================== -->
    <section class="slide content-slide">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <h2 class="reveal">Length-Adaptive GAE</h2>
                <span class="slide-number reveal">05 / 09</span>
            </div>

            <p class="reveal" style="margin-bottom: var(--content-gap); max-width: 800px;">Dynamically adjusts λ based on response length, optimizing the bias-variance tradeoff across heterogeneous sequence lengths.</p>

            <div class="gae-visual reveal">
                <div class="gae-bar-container">
                    <p style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Short Response</p>
                    <div class="gae-bar" style="height: 120px;">
                        <div class="gae-bar-fill" style="height: 30%;"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="gae-label">
                        <strong>λ = 0.2</strong><br>
                        Lower variance
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="gae-bar-container">
                    <p style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Medium Response</p>
                    <div class="gae-bar" style="height: 120px;">
                        <div class="gae-bar-fill" style="height: 55%;"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="gae-label">
                        <strong>λ = 0.5</strong><br>
                        Balanced
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="gae-bar-container">
                    <p style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Long Response</p>
                    <div class="gae-bar" style="height: 120px;">
                        <div class="gae-bar-fill" style="height: 85%;"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="gae-label">
                        <strong>λ = 0.9</strong><br>
                        Lower bias
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: 8px; padding: var(--content-gap); margin-top: var(--content-gap);" class="reveal">
                <p style="color: var(--text-primary);"><span class="highlight">Key insight:</span> Standard GAE uses fixed λ for all sequences. Length-Adaptive GAE matches λ to sequence characteristics—short sequences don't need high λ (high λ causes high variance when Monte Carlo and bootstrapping disagree). Long sequences benefit from higher λ (more bootstrapping helps when the value function is better trained).</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===========================================
         SLIDE 6: MAIN RESULTS
         =========================================== -->
    <section class="slide content-slide">
        <div class="slide-content">

                    <span class="bar-label" style="color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600;">VAPO</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <p class="chart-source reveal">AIME 2024 avg@32 • Same base model: Qwen2.5-32B • No SFT data</p>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===========================================
         SLIDE 7: TRAINING EFFICIENCY
         =========================================== -->
    <section class="slide content-slide">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-header">
                <h2 class="reveal">Training Efficiency: SOTA in 5K Steps</h2>
                <span class="slide-number reveal">07 / 09</span>
            </div>

            <div class="curve-container">

                </div>

                <div class="curve-stats">

                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-card reveal">
                        <h4>DAPO Peak</h4>

                        <div class="subtext">plateaus at ~5,500 steps</div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const options = {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 0.5
                };

                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgress();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, options);

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.nextSlide();
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.prevSlide();
                    }
                });
            }

            nextSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide < this.totalSlides - 1) {
                    this.currentSlide++;
                    this.scrollToSlide(this.currentSlide);
                }
            }

            prevSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide > 0) {
                    this.currentSlide--;
                    this.scrollToSlide(this.currentSlide);
                }
            }

            scrollToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.querySelector('.progress-bar');
            }

            updateProgress() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const navContainer = document.querySelector('.nav-dots');
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        this.currentSlide = i;
                        this.scrollToSlide(i);
                    });
                    navContainer.appendChild(dot);
                }
                this.navDots = navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.navDots.forEach((dot, index) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', index === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        // Initialize presentation
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>

52

55

58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);

68	    let captured = 1;

77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});
78	        captured++;
79	    }}
80

88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).

105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)

109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique

124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler

149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
